name: Ancien des pactes
description: A thin very old male chief with pale grey speckled skin and exceptionally long silver dreads in two thick cords. Long midnight-blue ceremonial robe with a narrow gold geometric border and wide belt carrying sealed bronze cylinders. He calmly holds a folded bronze-edged covenant folio against his chest. High bony shoulders, slightly bent elbows, no staff, long distinctive silhouette.
